req.title: Return 404 on unknown post
req.statement: The system shall respond with HTTP 404 when GET/POST /<id>/update or /<id>/delete references a non-existent post id.

doc.reasoning: The requirement specifies that the system should return a 404 error when attempting to update or delete a non-existent post. This behavior needs to be verified through positive, negative, and boundary test cases to ensure robustness against common mutations.

tests.name: test_update_non_existent_post
preconditions: Post ID does not exist in the database
tests.executable:
from flaskr import create_app
import tempfile, os
fd, path = tempfile.mkstemp(); os.close(fd)
app = create_app({'TESTING': True, 'DATABASE': path})
client = app.test_client()

# Log in as a valid user
client.post('/auth/login', data={'username': 'Rahul', 'password': 'stone'})

# Attempt to update a non-existent post
r = client.get('/999/update')
assert r.status_code == 404

tests.name: test_update_boundary_post_id
preconditions: Post ID is at the boundary of existing IDs
tests.executable:
from flaskr import create_app
import tempfile, os
fd, path = tempfile.mkstemp(); os.close(fd)
app = create_app({'TESTING': True, 'DATABASE': path})
client = app.test_client()

# Log in as a valid user
client.post('/auth/login', data={'username': 'Rahul', 'password': 'stone'})

# Attempt to update a post with ID just outside the existing range
r = client.get('/21/update')
assert r.status_code == 404
